offset18.meaning: Curve initialization offset parameter (offset18) used for the stored OFFSET conversion

user_has_deposit.meaning: User holds an open deposit in the curve

full_withdrawal_attempted.meaning: A full withdrawal of the user's deposit is attempted

full_withdrawal_covers_entire_deposit.meaning: The attempted withdrawal covers the user's entire deposited position so the reported redemption path applies

withdrawal_reverts.meaning: The full withdrawal deterministically reverts with PANIC(0x11) arithmetic underflow (execution outcome)

claims.scope: Full withdrawal of a user's deposited assets from OffsetProgressiveCurve

preconditions.text: OffsetProgressiveCurve was initialized with an offset18 parameter smaller than 1e9.; The user has a deposit (open position) in the curve whose full withdrawal is attempted.; The attempted full withdrawal covers the user's entire deposit so that the reported underflowing conversion path is the applicable redemption path for their position.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: Users should be able to fully withdraw their deposited assets from OffsetProgressiveCurve without the withdrawal reverting and trapping funds (inferred from the claimed trapped-funds failure).
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: The full withdrawal deterministically reverts with PANIC(0x11) arithmetic underflow.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The antecedent is the conjunction of the low-offset initialization, the user's open deposit, and the full-withdrawal coverage; the pattern condition is the full-withdrawal attempt.

The report's stated bound (offset18 < 1e9) is taken as the public condition; the truncation mechanism's stricter requirement (OFFSET18 < 1e18) is the implementation route that the stated bound also satisfies, converging on a stored OFFSET of 0.
The underflowing revert is asserted deterministically and generally for the full-withdrawal path under a low-offset curve, so no concrete deposit or share quantity is required.
The actor is the depositing user exercising a normal full withdrawal; no attacker or authorization claim is part of this property.

limitations: funds_trapped (permanent blocking and trapped funds) is a downstream consequence of the revert core V and is deferred rather than selected as a direct impact.
The internal arithmetic (offset squaring to 0; squaredShares < inner causing PANIC(0x11)) is implementation root cause, not part of the semantic property.
Alternative exits such as partial withdrawals or admin recovery are not modeled; 'permanently blocked' is taken from the report assertion.
The security intent is a normative requirement used only to justify the forbidden-effect reading; it is not an observable precondition.
